claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V5 — Adversarial Convergence Gates + Pedagogy Universalization. The autonomy orchestrator runs planner_drainer + worker_drainer + auto_merge unconditionally with no primary↔challenger convergence gate and no post-implementation adversarial review. Operator vision (2026-05-16): every plan must be reviewed continuously with two agents debating back-and-forth until validation is complete, and after implementation agents must again check for gaps. V5 wires the existing plan_convergence (1479 LOC) + convergent_planning_bridge (119 LOC) infrastructure into the runtime so Gate A (pre-worker convergence) gates worker_drainer, Gate B (post-impl review) gates auto_merge_runner. Pedagogy universalization extends V4's pedagogy-tier discipline from 9 ARIA agents to all 84 agents (75 currently without narrative pairings); operator's 'orneklerle acıklanmalı' principle becomes mandatory for Tier-1+Tier-3.
